_doc: One festival a season on a planet (js/festivals.js). when: 'weekend' (the default: Saturday and Sunday, Eastern time, of that season's last week), 'fullmoon' (Sylvara: while the real moon is full, js/clock.js moon()), or 'bloom' (Lumar: a spore bloom day in that season, js/bloom.js; a season with none keeps its last weekend). hours: [from, to] anchors (js/hours.js) of each planet-day the contests are open. crowd: who gathers where while it's on (js/routines.js) [x, y, facing, pose?]. props: what's put up [kind, x, y] (solid while it's on; drawn in code, js/festivals.js prop()). contests (or one contest): show (hand the judge things from your pack: entries scores each kind, ±30% for how fine it is; your best counts), derby (the biggest fish caught on the planet while it's on: score 'kind' scores a fish against the biggest of its kind, 100 points, else centimetres; rivals [who, fish, low, high]) or times (your quickest run of a ski run while it's on: rivals [who, low s, high s]). Each pays a placing once a festival, coins and a rosette. show/title/judging: the contest's words. stall: what's sold. poster: a line pinned on the planet's notice boards while it's on or coming. music: the tune while it's open (js/audio.js THEMES).

blossom_show.name: The Blossom Show
blossom_show.line: Tubs of flowers on the green, and Nell and Marigold with a clipboard each
blossom_show.poster: THE BLOSSOM SHOW ON THE GREEN, SATURDAY AND SUNDAY. FLOWERS, HONEY AND THINGS THAT SMELL NICE. JUDGES: NELL ASHBY, MARIGOLD LARKIN. NO GOATS.

contest.label: FLOWER TABLE
contest.title: the flower show
contest.judging: NELL AND MARIGOLD LEAN IN, SNIFF, AND WRITE ON THEIR CLIPBOARDS WITHOUT LETTING THE OTHER SEE.
contest.bring: Bring what you've grown that flowers: moonflowers picked by night, sunflowers, a posy at a pinch - or what the bees made of them.

strawberry_supper.name: The Strawberry Supper
strawberry_supper.line: Long tables out of the Hayloft, and Bridget judging the fruit
strawberry_supper.poster: THE STRAWBERRY SUPPER, THIS WEEKEND, TABLES OUT IN THE SQUARE BY THE HAYLOFT. BRING FRUIT, HONEY OR SOMETHING YOU'VE PRESSED. BRIDGET IS JUDGING AND HAS BEEN WARNED ABOUT FAVOURITES.

contest.label: SUPPER TABLE
contest.title: the fruit and honey
contest.judging: BRIDGET TASTES A LITTLE OF EVERYTHING, WITH HER EYES SHUT, AND SAYS 'MM' IN SEVERAL DIFFERENT WAYS.
contest.bring: Bring summer off the farm: strawberries, a twin-moon melon, starfruit, honey, a jar of jam, your own cider.

harvest_fair.name: The Harvest Fair
harvest_fair.line: Bunting and pies, and Old Ludd judging the produce
harvest_fair.poster: THE HARVEST FAIR IN THE SQUARE, SATURDAY AND SUNDAY. OLD LUDD JUDGES THE PRODUCE. EDDA'S PIE WELCOME, IF ANYONE'S GOT THE KNACK OF IT.

contest.label: JUDGING TABLE
contest.title: the produce show
contest.judging: OLD LUDD WEIGHS IT, SNIFFS IT, HOLDS IT TO THE LIGHT.
contest.bring: Bring produce off the farm: a pumpkin, starfruit, a sunflower, apples, honey, eggs - and Edda's apple pie, if you have it.

cellar_fair.name: The Cellar Fair
cellar_fair.line: The casks come up from the cellar, and Rosalind Vane tastes what's in them
cellar_fair.poster: THE CELLAR FAIR AT VINEHALLOW, THIS WEEKEND, UNDER THE PLANE TREE. WINE BY ITS AGE, CHEESE FROM YOUR OWN MILK, CIDER, CROCKS. ROSALIND VANE TASTES. THE HILL IS STEEP; THE WINE IS WORTH IT.

contest.label: TASTING TABLE
contest.title: the tasting
contest.judging: ROSALIND SWIRLS IT, HOLDS IT UP TO THE WINTER LIGHT, AND WRITES SOMETHING VERY SMALL IN HER BOOK.
contest.bring: Bring what you've put by: wine from your own cask (the longer it's lain, the better it scores), your farmhouse cheese, your cider, a crock of honey.

ice_fair.name: The Ice Fair
ice_fair.line: Torches round the rink, a derby through the ice, and the race down Pinewood
ice_fair.poster: THE ICE FAIR, THE LAST WEEKEND OF WINTER, ON THE PROMENADE. THE ICE DERBY (BIGGEST FISH THROUGH THE ICE, FOR ITS KIND - TOVE MEASURES) AND THE PINEWOOD RACE (LIV KEEPS THE CLOCK). CHESTNUTS. FONDUE. FALL OVER ON THE RINK AT NO EXTRA CHARGE.

contests.label: ICE DERBY
contests.title: the ice derby
contests.judging: THE BIGGEST FISH THROUGH THE ICE ON HOARFELL THIS ICE FAIR, AGAINST THE BIGGEST OF ITS KIND. TOVE MEASURES, AND ARGUES.
contests.bring: Fish through the ice anywhere on Hoarfell while it's on - Fellhaven's ice hole. A big char scores; a big frostfin scores just as well.

contests.label: RACE BOARD
contests.title: the Pinewood race
contests.judging: PINEWOOD, GATE TO ARCH, FASTEST TIME THIS ICE FAIR. LIV CHALKS THEM UP AND UNDERLINES HER OWN.
contests.bring: Ski Pinewood (the blue) on the pistes while it's on - from its start hut, against the clock. Your quickest counts.

lantern_tide.name: Lantern Tide
lantern_tide.line: Lanterns on the water for everyone the sea has kept
lantern_tide.poster: LANTERN TIDE ON CROWNHAVEN QUAY, THE LAST WEEKEND OF AUTUMN, AFTER DARK. LANTERNS AT THE STALL. THE DERBY: THE BIGGEST FISH ON LUMAR, THE BOSUN CHALKS THEM UP.

contest.label: DERBY BOARD
contest.title: the derby
contest.judging: THE BIGGEST FISH LANDED ON LUMAR THIS LANTERN TIDE. THE BOSUN CHALKS THEM UP.
contest.bring: Fish anywhere on Lumar while it's on. Your biggest goes on the board.
